chunks: And whatever is in it from Abū ʿAbdillāh al-Khurāsānī, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbdillāh, from Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim, from Abū ʿAbdillāh al-Khurāsānī.

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْخُرَاسَانِيِّ: Abū ʿAbdillāh al-Khurāsānī, the narrator to whom this transmission chain leads
key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: May Allah be pleased with him; an honorific supplication for the narrator’s father
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; an expression indicating the author’s narration of the report

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Abū ʿAbdillāh al-Khurāsānī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Abū ʿAbdillāh al-Khurāsānī. It serves as a technical note in hadith transmission, identifying the intermediaries in the chain and preserving the source lineage of the narration.
